doc: Per (op_kind, ep_size) correction factor: profiler median latency / aiconfigurator SOL alpha-beta latency at GLM-5 reference shape (H=6144, M=128, K=8). Each ep is anchored to its OWN SOL — the previous version divided through ep=1, which gave misleadingly small factors at intra-node ep and inflated factors at cross-node ep. Apply as scalar multiplier on top of aiconfigurator's analytical comm model.
